verdict.rationale: ROS 2's documented features are middleware/tooling for building and introspecting a single robot's software graph (topics, services, actions, CLI tools, bags, QoS, security) — there is no evidence of a fleet-wide dashboard showing health, location, and status across multiple robots. Community commentary also frames ROS 2 as a per-robot framework requiring custom layers for production fleet operations, not a fleet-management console.
